title: What The Oud Knows — EN/AR/ES (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal oud English Arabic Spanish language learning trilingual world instruments
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The oud is the oldest instrument in the room
By about three thousand years
It doesn't mention this
But it plays with the authority of something
That has been doing this longer than most civilisations

[Verse 2 — عربي]
أحد عشر وتراً وبلا دساتين [Eleven strings and no frets]
العود يرفض الدساتين [The oud refuses frets]
الدساتين للآلات التي قررت أين الأنغام [Frets are for instruments that have decided where the notes are]
العود يعرف أن الأنغام ليست ثابتة [The oud knows the notes are not fixed]
العود يعزف بينها [The oud plays between them]

[Chorus — English]
What the oud knows
Has no fixed position
The sliding note, the maqam and the mode
What the oud knows — the oud has always known

[Bridge — Español]
Chas encontró a un músico de oud en un festival [Chas found an oud player once at a festival]
Dijo — ¿por qué sin trastes? [Said — why no frets?]
El músico dijo — porque el sentimiento está entre las notas [The player said — because the feeling is between the notes]
Chas asintió [Chas nodded]
Dijo — eso es la bola más lenta [Said — that's the slower ball]
Eso es exactamente la bola más lenta [That's exactly the slower ball]

[Verse 3 — English]
Every language keeps itself alive
In the instrument that understands it best

[Outro — EN/AR/ES]
What the oud knows
ما تعرفه العود [What the oud knows]
Lo que sabe el oud [What the oud knows]
That's my boy
